Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Servicing of Spray Dryer unit and supply of CONTROL PANEL BOX (1 nos) for existing S pray Dryer unit - 1 nos SCOPE OF WORK Installation of CONTROL PANEL BOX for existing Spray Dryer unit at Plant , Peenya campus. It is su bmitted that the Stainless Steel (SS) Powder-Making Spray Dryer available at the Institute requires necessary repair, servicing and replacement/installation of the control panel for making the equip ment operational and suitable for further R&D activities. The Spray Dryer is required for preparation of lignin powder and other value-added bio-based mat erials from industrial by-products and residual wastes. The equipment will be utilized for research and development related to the preparation of bio-adhesives from black liquor, bio-tar, lignin and other residual industrial wastes, with the objective of developing sustainable and value added bio- based products. For restoring the equipment to working condition, the following works are required: 1. Repair and servicing of the existing SS Powder-Making Spray Dryer. 2. Installation of a suitable control panel box for safe and efficient operation of the equipment. 3. Inspection and servicing of associated electrical, mechanical and operational components. 4. Testing, commissioning and trial operation of the Spray Dryer after completion of the repair

and installation work. Terms and Conditions Work should be done at buyer place, - IWST peenya campus, Bangalore. No charges will be allowed for freight, transportation, insurance, shipping, storage, handling, demurrage, c artage, packaging or similar charges unless provided for in the applicable Purchase Order or otherwise agreed to in writing by Buyer. The service provider should be registered/authorized service provider, should enclose proprietary certifica te/OEM certificate if any. The bidder should have a registered office in Bangalore. The Bidder should not sublet the contract. Rates for each items to be replaced should should be specified separately in the bid, Work should be done within 45 days after receiving order. Services during warranty period (min 1 year) services should be done in place AMC services should be provided in case given Payment will be made after receipt of invoice/Bill. Payment will be made after successful completion of work. ** Before participating in the biding the firm are requested to visit IWST Peenya Camp us and see the items as listed above and clarify any information about the work/items with the End user.
